profile_identity: Historical study label for the pre-v4 root-cause investigation; safe_action names the final qualified profile.

causal_factor.class: KV cache sizing omits post-allocation graph and execution headroom
causal_factor.mechanism: profile_available_cache_memory_bytes sizes the KV pool before decode graph capture by subtracting only total_gpu_memory * (1 - gpu_memory_utilization) from then-available memory. At TP=4's 0.95 default this produced a 21,361,024-token pool and left 10.94 GiB before C32 capture. Subsequent generation faulted. Holding gpu_memory_utilization at 0.95 but capping the pool to the passing 0.94-run size, 21,097,536 tokens, removed the fault.
causal_factor.scope: Base GPT-OSS runtime below AR+RMSNorm; reproduced with fusion disabled.
causal_factor.supersession: KV capacity changes incidence but is not the root cause. Graph padding aliased live request slot 0; see graph-padding-sentinel-root-cause.json.

causal_controls.result: GPU node-5 memory access fault at the first measured prefill
GPU node-5 memory access fault at the first measured prefill

falsified_hypotheses.evidence: The live GPT-OSS configuration reported paged_cache_groups=[]; an opt-in negative-page invariant never fired; the fault occurred in eager prefill before decode.
The fault reproduced with fusion disabled and in prior RCCL-only controls.

falsified_hypotheses.hypothesis: prefill graph, overlap, or asynchronous launch alone
falsified_hypotheses.evidence: The boundary controls used eager prefill, disabled overlap, and prior serialization controls still faulted at the larger KV pool.

falsified_hypotheses.hypothesis: foreign process or one defective selected GPU
falsified_hypotheses.evidence: KFD monitoring found no foreign selected-GPU process; pass and fail controls used the same canonical physical GPUs 0,2,1,4 and differed only in KV allocation.

safe_action.reason: 0.90 retains conservative memory margin; the graph-padding sentinel fix closes the metadata corruption mechanism.
safe_action.runtime_change: No global TP=4 memory default change; folded copy-in is disabled globally until its producer-publication contract is proven. Other models and graph/workload envelopes require their own memory qualification.
